provenance: The hypothesis direction was generated after observing that all 18 frozen V1.1 cells had negative recovery Q5-Q1 spreads at h5/h10/h20. This anatomy may generate a future hypothesis but cannot confirm Alpha.

sample.sample_type: SHOCK only; GENERIC_W2/W3/W5 are reused only for the frozen generic comparison
sample.bucket_orientation: Q1 weakest recovery/continued deterioration; Q5 strongest recovery

bucket_metrics: severe_loss_incidence at h20 only from the accepted MAE <= -10% convention; null at shorter horizons

baseline_decomposition.event_mean: equal-observation mean over all complete Q1-Q5 shock events within the same cell and horizon
baseline_decomposition.contribution_share: positive Q1-strength contribution divided by Q1-Q5 when Q1-Q5 is positive; Q5 weakness is the residual

monotonicity.adjacent_favorable_step: bucket mean at Qk is greater than bucket mean at Q(k+1)
monotonicity.bucket_spearman: Spearman rho of bucket numbers 1..5 with bucket mean return
monotonicity.broadly_monotonic_cell_horizon: at least 3 of 4 favorable adjacent steps and rho <= -0.70

continuous_diagnostics.recovery_fraction: mean same-date cross-sectional Spearman rho within cell, minimum five complete observations/date
continuous_diagnostics.further_drawdown_ratio: mean same-date cross-sectional Spearman rho within cell, minimum five complete observations/date

controls.shock_severity: reuse V1.1 absolute bins [threshold,8%),[8%,10%),[10%,infinity) and relative bins [threshold,6%),[6%,8%),[8%,infinity)
controls.pre_shock_trend: reuse causal prior-20 log-return within-date terciles
controls.realized_volatility: reuse causal prior-20 sample-volatility within-date terciles
controls.q1_positive_control_cell: supported at least 100 complete observations; Q1 absolute and industry-relative mean both > 0
controls.generic_recovery: compare exact GENERIC_W2/W3/W5 Q1 long means with ABS_m06_REL_m04 at the same W; no new matching

family_counts.family_aggregate: equal-weight mean of the 18 cell-level statistics so nested cell event counts do not choose the family conclusion
family_counts.monotonic_cell: absolute and industry-relative both satisfy broadly_monotonic_cell_horizon

classification_gates.chronologically_unstable: aggregate Q1 absolute or industry-relative mean changes sign between early and late in at least two of h5/h10/h20
classification_gates.post_hoc_long_reversal_candidate: at each h5/h10/h20 at least 12/18 cells have Q1 absolute mean > 0, Q1 industry-relative mean > 0, both > 0, absolute median > 0, and both-coordinate monotonicity; aggregate Q1 absolute and industry-relative means are > 0 in both blocks at all three horizons; mean Q1-strength contribution share across h5/h10/h20 is at least 0.25
classification_gates.relative_reversal_only: at each h5/h10/h20 at least 12/18 cells have Q1 industry-relative mean > 0 and both blocks have positive aggregate Q1 industry-relative means, while the absolute-long candidate gate fails
classification_gates.strong_recovery_avoidance_only: at each h5/h10/h20 fewer than 12/18 cells have both Q1 means positive, at least 12/18 cells have Q5 absolute and industry-relative means below their event means, and mean Q1-strength contribution share is below 0.25
classification_gates.defensive_less_bad_only: the prior categories fail, aggregate Q1 absolute mean is not positive across all primary horizons, and at least 12/18 cells have lower Q1 severe-loss incidence than the event sample at h20
classification_gates.nonmonotonic_bucket_effect: the prior categories fail and fewer than 9/18 cells are broadly monotonic in both coordinates at each of at least two primary horizons
classification_gates.no_long_reversal_alpha: none of the preceding categories applies

prohibited: new parameter cells or reordered grid
new shock, recovery, or further-drawdown definitions
